title: Finblox uses FBX conversion and selective buybacks for affected balances
description: Finblox used a recovery approach that included converting affected customer debt into FBX tokens and a buyback programme; contemporaneous reporting documented several customers who received their deposited cash back while others continued to report unresolved losses.
notes: The exact February 2023 start day is not established, so the event date is month-level represented as 2023-02-01. Selective full recoveries do not establish universal repayment, and FBX conversion is not treated as cash repayment at par.
